title: China Hami Nuclear Silo Field — 80+ Launch Pads, Octagonal Installations, Armored Bunkers (Reuters Satellite Imagery)
snippet: Commercial satellite imagery reviewed by Reuters and assessed by 3 independent security analysts shows China building 80+ concrete launch pads, 2 octagonal installations, armored bunkers, and fiber-optic command nodes across thousands of km2 of Xinjiang desert near Hami ICBM silo fields. Infrastructure supports mobile missile launchers, air defense, EW, satcom. Scale described as unprecedented among nuclear-armed states.
